# Kani output fixtures

Hand-written from Kani's documented `cargo kani` output format (v0.5x: `Check N:` /
`- Status:` / `- Description:` / `- Location:` blocks, a per-harness `VERIFICATION:-` line, and a
final `Complete - …` line). They were **not** captured from a real run, because Kani isn't
installed in this environment. Replace them with recorded output in ROADMAP P5.
